name: Berkshire Nature Camp at Pleasant Valley
description_short: Weekly outdoor nature day camp at Mass Audubon's Pleasant Valley Wildlife Sanctuary in Lenox, running 9 am to 3 pm, Monday to Friday. Groups for ages 4–12 do trail walks, wildlife observation, games and crafts, and there is a Counselor-in-Training program for ages 14–17.
special_needs_notes: Campers must be able to move about on uneven terrain because camp is outdoors and exploratory.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This page shows the 2026 season only (June 22–August 14, 2026), which has already ended. Dates, prices and registration details for 2027 have not been posted.

Each session entry covers a whole program's season (June 22–August 14), not a single bookable week. The specific weeks offered for each group are on the linked 'See available sessions' pages, which were not read.
Prices are a sliding scale of $104–$518 per session. The tier you get depends on availability. Families registering at Tiers 4 or 5 must hold an active family-level or higher Mass Audubon membership.
The CIT program ($125) requires an online application and in-person training at the start of the summer.
The only phone number and address on the page are for Mass Audubon headquarters in Lincoln, MA, not the camp, so they were not recorded.
